abilities.name: Parasitic Bio-Toxins
abilities.text: Immediately after a Friendly Infested Unit ends their action Within 8″ of an Enemy Unit, that Enemy Unit gains the INFESTATION Status. This effect is treated as a DEBUFF.

abilities.name: Scanner Sweep
abilities.text: Set a Faction Indicator anywhere on the battlefield. While Enemy Units are Within 6″ of this Faction Indicator, they lose the HIDDEN Status.
